Mumbai is transforming faster than ever and the Navi Mumbai International Airport (NMIA) is at the heart of this change. Developed by Adani Group, this $4.5 billion mega airport project will completely redefine how Mumbai connects to the world.
In this video, we explore how Navi Mumbai International Airport Private Limited (NMIAL) is building one of India’s most advanced aviation hubs with world-class design, digital innovation, and seamless connectivity through Atal Setu, Mumbai Metro, Mumbai Expressways, Suburban Rail, and even the upcoming Mumbai Water Taxi.
